description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableThingRevision' implementing the 'ThingRevision' interface. It encapsulates a revision number (long) and provides methods for comparison, incrementing, and conversion, along with standard overrides for equality and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableThingRevision
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the 'ThingRevision' interface, encapsulating a long revision value with comparison, increment, and utility methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ImmutableThingRevision with the specified long value.

methods.name: isGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if this revision is greater than the specified other revision.

methods.name: isGreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is greater than or equal to the specified other revision.

methods.name: isLowerThan
methods.description: Checks if this revision is lower than the specified other revision.

methods.name: isLowerThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is less than or equal to the specified other revision.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutableThingRevision instance with its value incremented by one.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this revision with another ThingRevision.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Returns the long value of this revision.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this revision.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this object and another.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of this object.
